verdict.rationale: Unity documents strong background/automation building blocks — headless mode via command-line/editor args, a dedicated Unity CLI for CI pipelines, and a Build Automation/continuous-integration service — which let scripted builds and workflows run unattended (unity-docs-7,8,25,26,28; unity-probe-rt-4). However, none of this evidence shows an AI-native user configuring a persistent, autonomous agentic automation (e.g., a scheduled/triggered agent task that runs and monitors itself); the MCP/AI Assistant integration is framed as an interactive, prompt-driven tool rather than a background autonomous process. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/triggered autonomous agent runs, monitoring/alerting for background automations, and first-party framing of MCP/CLI as an unattended agentic scheduler rather than CI scripting or interactive assistant use.
